references.text: The prophecy about Elijah who is to come before the great and dreadful day of the Lord.
Reference to a voice crying in the wilderness, 'Prepare the way of the Lord,' often associated with prophetic activity.
Reference to God's word that came to Hosea, which serves as an example of prophetic activity.
Jesus identifies John the Baptist as the Elijah who was to come.
The disciples' discussion with Jesus about the coming of Elijah and the identification of John the Baptist as Elijah.
